assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The documented diagnoses of R00.2 and R42 support the medical necessity of this service.
The service was for correlating the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
